lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, featuring a prominent vertical column of three blobs followed by a series of more widely spaced, larger blobs along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance where the blobs serve as intersecting nodes, most clearly defined in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) positioned near the pectoral fin and ventral to the gill slits.
